name: Accelerated Metabolism
description: Everything runs fast inside you. Every 10 in-game minutes, hunger increases by +0.05 and thirst increases by +0.03.

name: Acrophobic
description: Heights make your stomach drop and your hands shake. The higher up you are, the harder it is to function.

name: Action Hero
description: You fight like the hero of your own action movie. With at least 3 living enemies within 10 tiles, equipped weapons gain 15 percentage points of critical chance, up to 100 percent. Checked every 30 player updates. Disabled by Mundane.

name: Adaptive Metabolism
description: Your body draws on stored calories before signaling hunger. While you have positive caloric reserves, passive hunger cannot drop your meter below roughly 99 percent full. Eating still works normally. Once caloric reserves are depleted, hunger advances unmodified and you can starve.

name: Caffeine Addict
description: Without recent caffeine, stress increases by +0.06 every 10 in-game minutes. Consuming caffeine prevents the next increase.

name: Albino
description: Sunlight wears you down. Every minute spent outdoors from 06:00 through 17:59 adds 0.03 stress and 0.02 fatigue, up to each meter's maximum.

name: Alcoholic I
description: While intoxication is below 5, stress increases by +0.05 every 30 in-game minutes.

name: Alcoholic II
description: While intoxication is below 5, stress increases by +0.10 every 10 in-game minutes.

name: Alcoholic III
description: While intoxication is below 10, stress increases by +0.05 every in-game minute; below 5, panic also increases by +3.

name: Allergic
description: Your body reacts badly to things that others tolerate fine. Food allergies can turn a meal into a medical event.

name: Amateur Electrician
description: Weekend electrical projects taught you more than most people know. +1 to Electrical.

name: Analgesia
description: You feel no pain. All pain is permanently suppressed regardless of injuries.

name: Anemic
description: Low iron levels slow your healing. Wound bleed decay is 3× slower (wounds close much slower than normal).

name: Anorexia
description: Your relationship with food is deeply complicated. Each time you eat, stress increases by 0.10 (10 percent of the stress meter).

name: Anti-Gun Activist
description: You spent years campaigning against firearms and never touched one. XP gain in Aiming and Reloading is reduced to ×0.5 (-50 percent).

name: Antique Enthusiast
description: Your eye for rare and exceptional craftsmanship gives you a chance to find antique weapons and clothing hidden in crates and metal shelves. These items are significantly better than anything else you can find. Roughly 0.8 percent chance per eligible container, once per loot cycle.

name: Anti-Vaxxer
description: Your distrust of medicine makes you resistant to treatment. Medical items are less effective on you.

name: Ascetic
description: You subsist on the bare minimum. Eating within 1 hour of your last meal triggers a mood penalty (+10 unhappiness, +5 stress). Passive benefit: hunger builds up ~15 percent more slowly - your body needs less food.

name: Axe Fighter
description: +2 to Axe. All axe attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.

name: Backpacker
description: Efficient packing and load distribution let you carry more comfortably. Carry weight is increased.

name: Bad Teeth
description: Dental problems make eating painful. Eating causes increasing head pain (proportional to food healing). Food effectiveness is not reduced - it just hurts.

name: Battering Ram
description: You're a human freight train. While running or sprinting, entering collision range knocks each new nearby zombie down and drains endurance. Running drains 0.05 endurance; sprinting drains 0.03 and deals 0.15 impact damage. Martial Artist also applies its normal bonus damage. This does not prevent the game's normal trip or stagger.

name: Bigorexia
description: You are never big enough, never strong enough, never enough. Your mood suffers whenever your body does not match the image in your head.

name: Blade Fighter
description: Sharp steel is your answer to the undead. +2 to Long Blade and Short Blade.

name: Blade Twirl
description: +1 to Long Blade and Small Blade.

name: Blissfully Fit
description: +1 to Fitness. Passively gain happiness over time.

name: Blunt Fighter
description: You trust a solid bludgeon over any blade. +2 to Long Blunt and Short Blunt.

name: Blunt Twirl
description: +1 to Small Blunt and Blunt.

name: Bouncer I
description: Years of handling rough crowds taught you to roll with the punches. The next new injury you take after the cooldown is automatically downgraded to a lesser one (bite to laceration, laceration to scratch, fracture halved). 300-second base cooldown, reduced by 10 seconds per Strength level. Will not cure a pre-existing zombie infection.

name: Bouncer II
description: You have been hit so many times nothing fazes you. The next new injury you take after the cooldown is automatically downgraded to a lesser one (bite to laceration, laceration to scratch, fracture halved). 220-second base cooldown, reduced by 20 seconds per Strength level. Will not cure a pre-existing zombie infection.

name: Brittle
description: Your bones are fragile and snap under stress. Fracture chance is increased by +50%.

name: Broken
description: Your leg snapped before you even got started. You spawn with a fractured and injured left foot, stress at 0.5, and fatigue at 0.3.

name: Burned
description: Fire got to you before you got away. You spawn with 60 percent burn severity on your upper torso and both hands, stress at 0.7, fatigue at 0.5, and panic at 0.3.

name: Butterfingers
description: Things slip out of your hands at the worst moments. No matter how careful you try to be, stuff just ends up on the floor.

name: Weak Grip
description: Your base carry weight is reduced by 1.

name: Strong Grip
description: Your base carry weight is increased by 1.

name: Cleaver
description: +1 to Long Blade skill. Long blade attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.

name: Cold Sensitive
description: Cold cuts through you faster than it should. Even mild temperature drops affect your body and your focus.

name: Competitive Eater
description: You eat with purpose and efficiency. Each time you eat, boredom decreases by 10 points and hunger decreases by 0.05 (5 percent of the hunger meter).

name: Homebody
description: You feel most at ease indoors. While inside, boredom and unhappiness slowly decrease.

name: Crafty
description: Your hands know how to make something from nothing. +1 to Carpentry, Mechanics, and Tailoring.

name: Cruelty
description: You strike without mercy or hesitation. Start at level 1 in every melee weapon skill.

name: Depressive
description: A heavy sadness follows you everywhere. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress increases by +0.08.

name: Deprived
description: Years of neglect have left your body in poor condition. Multiple physical stats are reduced.

name: Driver
description: Countless hours behind the wheel have made you a natural. Improves vehicle top speed, engine power, and braking by 20 percent, and makes the engine 20 percent quieter.

name: Durability
description: You treat your gear with care and know how to make it last. Items you use degrade 25 percent slower (durability multiplier: ×1.25).

name: Evasive
description: +1 to Nimble and Sprinting. 50 percent chance to completely dodge incoming damage.

name: Expert Driver
description: Years behind the wheel have made you one of the best. Improves vehicle handling while driving.

name: Fast
description: +30 percent movement speed. Also slowly regenerates endurance (+0.01 per 30 ticks) while endurance is not full.

name: Fast Hands
description: Your hands move with fluid precision. Item transfers and reload actions complete 40 percent faster (transfer time multiplier: ×0.6).

name: Fearful
description: Fear comes quickly and hits hard. Each time a panic event fires, panic is increased by an additional +0.2.

name: Fear of the Dark
description: Darkness is not just inconvenient for you, it is genuinely frightening. Being in the dark wears away at your composure.

name: Fibromyalgia
description: Chronic pain is your constant companion. Everyday exertion costs more than it should, and bad days can be genuinely debilitating.

name: Fitted
description: Reduces the weight of each worn clothing item by 50%. Removes run and combat speed penalties from worn items. Effect updates every ~1 second.

name: Flailer
description: Your swings are wild and undisciplined. Combat accuracy is reduced by -15%. While panicking and running, you may stumble and fall.

name: Flat Earther
description: You distrust books, science, and anything written down. Reading speed is reduced by 30 percent and MetaGame XP is reduced to ×0.7 (-30 percent).

name: Flexible
description: +1 to Nimble.

name: Flimsy
description: You are not built for physical exertion. Strength and endurance are reduced.

name: Generator Know-How
description: You kept the lights on when the grid failed. +1 to Electrical.

name: Gimp
description: An old injury slows you down. -50 percent movement speed.

name: Glass Body
description: Your body feels like it was built to break. All incoming damage is multiplied by ×1.5 (+50 percent damage taken).

name: Gordanite
description: +2 to Cooking. Food you cook provides 50 percent more nutrition and calories.

name: Gourmand
description: Food is one of life's great pleasures. Each meal grants +50 percent bonus hunger relief and reduces boredom and unhappiness by the same proportion.

name: Grave Robber
description: +2 to Plant Scavenging.

name: Grunt
description: Raw power and aggression drive your fighting style. +1 to Carpentry, Short Blunt, Masonry, and Blacksmith.

name: Gun Specialist I
description: You have a knack for firearms. +1 to Aiming and Reloading.

name: Gun Specialist II
description: You handle firearms with practiced efficiency. +2 to Aiming and Reloading, +1 to Nimbleness.

name: Gun Specialist III
description: You are a firearms expert. +2 to Aiming and Reloading, +1 to Nimbleness. Reload and aim times are reduced by 10%. Equipped firearms never jam.

name: Gym-Goer
description: +1 to Strength and Fitness.

name: Hardy
description: You endure. When fatigue exceeds 0.8 an exhaustion phase begins, raising stress by +0.02 per minute. After 10 consecutive minutes of rest (fatigue below 0.3), exhaustion clears and a 5-minute bonus phase begins that slowly restores endurance (+0.002 per minute).

name: Heat Sensitive
description: Heat hits you harder than most. High temperatures sap your strength and leave you struggling when others are merely warm.

name: Heavily Bleeding Wounds
description: Even minor cuts refuse to close. Bleed rate is increased to 200 percent of normal - wounds bleed twice as fast.

name: Heavy Swing
description: You put your whole body into every blow. +2 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, Short Blade, Short Blunt, and Spear.

name: High Sweaty
description: You sweat profusely at the slightest exertion. Physical activity rapidly increases your wetness level.

name: Human Hamster
description: Carry 2 more weight. If your inventory is below 80% full or you are not wearing an inventory container, craving builds each minute and adds 0.02/0.04/0.08 stress per minute after 10/30/60 minutes.

name: Ideal Weight
description: You are in peak physical condition. Carry weight is increased by +1 and fatigue rate is reduced to 85 percent of normal.

name: Immune Response
description: Every 10 in-game minutes, zombie infection is reduced by 3, to a minimum of 0, and fatigue is reduced by 0.02.

name: Immunocompromised
description: Every in-game minute, existing zombie infection increases by 1, up to a maximum of 100.

name: Improviser
description: +1 to Maintenance skill. Equipped weapons degrade 50 percent slower.

name: Incomprehensive
description: Complex ideas just do not stick for you. Your effective skill cap is reduced by 2 in all skills.

name: Indefatigable
description: You do not know the meaning of worn out. While running, endurance slowly regenerates (+0.005 per 30 ticks). When endurance bottoms out, a 3-minute recovery timer starts and restores endurance to 50 percent on completion.

name: Ingenuitive
description: You find creative solutions where others see dead ends. +2 to Electrical and +1 to Metalworking.

name: Injured I
description: You start with injuries to your left hand and left foot, and stress at 0.3.

name: Injured II
description: You start with injuries to both hands, your left foot, and upper torso, with stress at 0.6 and fatigue at 0.4.

name: Iron Liver
description: Alcohol affects you about as much as water. Each real-world minute, drunkenness above 0.1 is reduced by 10 percent (multiplied by ×0.9).

name: Early Bird
description: You rise with the sun and hit the ground running. Between 6am and 6pm stress decreases by 0.02 per minute. Between 6pm and 6am stress increases by 0.02 per minute. Net effect over a full day is zero - purely a lifestyle trait.

name: Lead Foot
description: You always pushed vehicles past their limits. +20 percent vehicle top speed while driving.

name: Less Sweaty
description: You run cooler than most. Every in-game minute while awake, wetness is reduced by 3 indoors, 1.5 outdoors, and 0.5 in rain. If body temperature rises above 37.2 C, it cools by 0.08 C per minute, or 0.12 C above 37.7 C. This gives strong heat resistance under normal conditions, but does not make you heat-immune.

name: Long Blade
description: +2 to Long Blade. Long blade attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.

name: Luddite
description: Technology has always been your enemy. XP gain in Electrical is reduced to ×0.6 (-40 percent).

name: Lurcher
description: You move with a lumbering, uncoordinated gait. -15 percent movement speed and +15 percent longer work duration (actions take longer). When exhausted and moving, you may lose your footing.

name: Maniac
description: Combat wakes something up in you. Each time you kill a zombie, stress decreases by -0.15 and boredom decreases by -0.2.

name: Marathon Runner
description: +2 to Sprinting. Fatigue and endurance drain reduced by 15%.

name: Martial Artist
description: Your hands are lethal weapons. Each bare-hand hit spends 0.001 endurance and adds damage scaled by Short Blunt and pre-drain endurance. Normal bonus damage is 0.5 plus 0.05 per level; critical bonus damage is 3.0 plus 0.3 per level. Critical chance is 5 percent plus 8 percentage points per level. The damage multiplier is pre-drain endurance plus 0.35. Each hit grants Short Blunt experience equal to twice the bonus damage. Mundane disables the bonus.

name: Melancholic
description: The world feels muted and grey. A quiet sadness colors everything you do.

name: Motion Sickness
description: Vehicles do not agree with you. Even short drives leave you nauseous and desperate for still ground.

name: Silver Lining
description: Even at the end of the world, you find something to be glad about. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress decreases by -0.08 when stress is above 0.6, or -0.03 otherwise.

name: Mundane
description: You were never exceptional at anything. XP gain in Carpentry, Cooking, First Aid, Mechanics, Electrical, Aiming, and Reloading is reduced to ×0.8 (-20 percent). Also disables special combat abilities from other traits (Martial Artist, Action Hero).

name: Mushroomer
description: You know your fungi - the edible, the medicinal, and the deadly. +2 to Foraging.

name: Natural
description: +1 to Cooking skill. Movement speed +10 percent, reduced by 2 percent per clothing item worn (minimum 0 percent; bonus cannot go negative).

name: Nervous Wreck
description: Your nerves are always close to the edge. Each panic event adds +0.3 to panic. Additionally, every 10 in-game minutes while stress is above 0.7, panic increases by +0.05.

name: Ninja Way
description: You trained in the art of silent movement. +2 to Sneaking and +1 to Lightfooted.

name: Noodle Legs
description: Your legs never quite cooperate. -20 percent movement speed and constant endurance drain (-0.005/sec).

name: No XP: Axe
description: You'll never get any better with axes. Disables XP gain in Axe.

name: No XP: First Aid
description: You know medicine as well as you ever will. First Aid actions grant no XP.

name: No XP: Maintenance
description: Tool upkeep is routine. Maintenance grants no XP.

name: No XP: Shooting
description: You have already mastered firearms and no longer learn from using them. Aiming and Reloading grant no XP.

name: No XP: Sneaky
description: You will never improve at moving silently, no matter how much you practice. Disables XP gain in Sneaking and Lightfoot.

name: No XP: Tech
description: Electrical work holds no more lessons for you. Electrical and Mechanics grant no XP.

name: Olympian
description: +1 to Sprinting and Fitness. Fatigue and endurance drain reduced by 15%.

name: One-Handed
description: You fight best with one hand free. +2 to Short Blade and Short Blunt.

name: One Trick Pony
description: You excel only in what you know best. Training multiple skills simultaneously applies an XP penalty across all skills being trained.

name: Optimist
description: You genuinely believe things will work out. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress decreases by -0.06 and panic decreases by -0.04.

name: Night Owl
description: You come alive after dark. Every minute from 18:00 through 05:59 reduces stress by 0.02, down to 0. Every minute from 06:00 through 17:59 increases stress by 0.02, up to 1. The two 12-hour windows use equal and opposite rates. The effect does not depend on sleep or location.

name: Pacer
description: You have always had a brisk, purposeful walk. +15 percent movement speed. After ~20 seconds indoors, you become restless (+2 unhappiness per cycle).

name: Pack Mouse
description: You struggle to carry as much as most people. -2 base carry weight.

name: Pack Mule
description: You can haul far more than the average survivor. +6 base carry weight.

name: Panic Attacks
description: Without warning, your body convinces itself that death is seconds away. The attacks pass, but they leave you shaken.

name: Paramedic
description: +2 to Doctor. Medical treatments (bandaging, stitching) are applied 50 percent faster.

name: Paranoia
description: Every shadow hides something. Every 10 in-game minutes, panic increases by +0.06.

name: Pessimist
description: You expect the worst and, frankly, you are usually right. Every 10 in-game minutes, stress increases by +0.05.

name: Photographic Memory
description: You learn everything faster. All XP gain is increased to ×1.5 (+50 percent). Reading is 3× faster. While reading, panic and stress are forced to 0 and boredom/unhappiness drop rapidly. Finishing a skill book grants a flat XP bonus by tier: +12 / +30 / +65 / +120 / +200.

name: Physically Active
description: You have always pushed your body and it pays off. Exercise yields more fitness gains for you than it does for others.

name: Pill Allergy
description: Medicine that helps others can hurt you. Certain pills trigger an adverse reaction instead of the relief they promise.

name: Pit Crew
description: +2 to Mechanics. Vehicle repair and maintenance actions are 50 percent faster.

name: Student Driver
description: You never quite got the hang of driving. Worsens vehicle handling while driving.

name: Prepared: Ammunition
description: You stockpiled ammunition and reloaded your own rounds. +1 to Aiming and Reloading.

name: Prepared: Camping
description: You lived off the land long before the outbreak. +1 to Fishing and Trapping.

name: Prepared: Carpentry
description: You fortified and reinforced your home long before the dead rose. +1 to Carpentry.

name: Prepared: Vehicles
description: You kept your vehicles in top condition and knew basic mechanics. +1 to Mechanics.

name: Prepared: Food
description: You spent countless hours preserving and preparing food before the outbreak. +1 to Cooking.

name: Prepared: Medical
description: You took first-aid courses and kept a well-stocked medical kit. +1 to First Aid.

name: Prepared: Pack
description: You packed your bag with obsessive care before everything fell apart. Increases your base carry weight by +3.

name: Prepared: Weapons
description: You kept your gear in fighting shape. +1 to Maintenance.

name: Pro: Blade
description: Specialised training with bladed weapons. +2 to Long Blade and Short Blade.

name: Pro: Blunt
description: Specialised training with blunt weapons. +2 to Long Blunt and Short Blunt.

name: Prodigy
description: You pick up new skills at an extraordinary rate. Start at level 1 in Cooking, Carpentry, Mechanics, First Aid, Fitness, Sprinting, Tailoring, Electrical, Aiming, and Reloading.

name: Pro: Firearms
description: Specialised firearms training. +2 to Aiming and Reloading.

name: Pro: Spear
description: +2 to Spear. Spear attacks have +10 percent critical hit chance.

name: Quick Rest
description: Your body bounces back from exhaustion fast. Sleep quality is increased by +30%.

name: Quick Worker
description: You always got the job done ahead of schedule. +30 percent work speed on all crafting and building actions.

name: Quiet
description: You naturally move without making noise. +1 to Sneaking and Lightfooted.

name: Ravenous
description: Your appetite is relentless. Every 10 in-game minutes, hunger increases by +0.1.

name: Restful Sleeper
description: You drop into a deep sleep the moment your head hits the pillow. Sleep quality is increased by +50 percent, allowing faster fatigue recovery from rest.

name: Scaredy Cat
description: You startle easily and panic often. When panic rises by at least 5 points between one-minute checks, 15 additional panic points are added. When at least 9 living zombies are spotted, each eligible player update has a 3 percent chance to make you scream and attract attention. After a scream, this chance pauses for 120 player updates.

name: Scrapper
description: You see value in broken machinery and scrap. Start at Metalworking level 1, Maintenance level 1, and Blacksmithing level 1.

name: Scrounger
description: +1 to Plant Scavenging. When opening a container for the first time, 30 percent chance to find an additional item.

name: Second Wind
description: Just when you think you are done, something kicks in. While sprinting with endurance at or below 0.1, endurance is instantly restored by +0.3. This triggers once per 10-minute cooldown.

name: Sedentary
description: Your body has grown accustomed to doing as little as possible. Fitness fades faster for you without consistent effort.

name: Self-Destructive
description: You have always been your own worst enemy. You act against your own interests in ways that are hard to explain, even to yourself.

name: Sensitive Stomach
description: Your digestive system does not take kindly to stress or poor food. Meals that others handle fine can leave you miserable.

name: Sharpshooter
description: +2 to Aiming. Equipped firearms have 25 percent more hit chance and effective range.

name: Short Blade
description: +2 to Small Blade. Small Blade weapons have +10 critical-chance points, and primary-hand attacks with them have 50 percent lower melee delay.

name: Slack
description: Effort was never really your thing. +40 percent work duration on all crafting and building actions (actions take 40 percent longer).

name: Sloth
description: Extreme laziness has kept you from developing any physical fitness. Fitness is at its lowest.

name: Slow Worker
description: You take your sweet time with everything. -50 percent work speed on all crafting and building actions (+50 percent work duration).

name: Snorer
description: You rattle the walls when you sleep. Noise output while sleeping is doubled (×2.0 noise multiplier), attracting nearby zombies.

name: Chronically Sore
description: Persistent muscle soreness limits your physical performance. Endurance and strength are reduced.

name: Sore Legs
description: Your legs are weak and prone to fatigue. -20 percent movement speed and -2 base carry weight.

name: Spear Fighter
description: You keep the dead at arm's length with a well-placed thrust. +2 to Spear.

name: Specialist: First Aid
description: A dedicated medical professional. Start at First Aid level 9.

name: Specialist: Crafting
description: Your life revolved around making and building things. +4 to Carpentry, Metalworking, Masonry, Tailoring, and Electrical. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.

name: Specialist: Food
description: You were a culinary professional or devoted homesteader. +4 to Cooking, Farming, Fishing, and Foraging. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.

name: Specialist: Firearms
description: A lifelong firearms enthusiast. +4 to Aiming and Reloading. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.

name: Specialist: Movement
description: Your body is a finely tuned machine. +4 to Sprinting, Nimbleness, Lightfooted, and Sneaking. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.

name: Specialist: Weapons
description: You dedicated your pre-apocalypse life to weapons mastery. +4 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, Short Blade, Short Blunt, and Spear. Mutually exclusive with other Specialist traits.

name: Sprint Demon
description: You were born to run. Start at Sprinting level 1.

name: Squirrel
description: Fatigue accumulates more slowly while running or sprinting.

name: Staunch
description: You have solid medical training and recover from treated wounds well. +1 to First Aid. Bandaged wounds stop bleeding faster, but unbandaged wounds are unaffected.

name: Strong and Nimble
description: +2 to Nimble, +1 to Strength. You do not suffer random falls while climbing fences or intact ropes.

name: Sunday Runner
description: Sprinting increases unhappiness by 2 every in-game minute.

name: Super Immune
description: Your immune system is exceptional. Infections that would lay others low barely register with your body.

name: Swift
description: Light on your feet, you move faster than most. +1 to Lightfooted.

name: Taut
description: Lean muscle built through calisthenics. +2 to Fitness.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 to Small Blunt. Stomping a downed zombie kills it instantly.

name: Terminator
description: Nothing will stop you. +4 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, Short Blade, Short Blunt, Spear, Aiming, and Reloading.

name: Thick Blooded
description: Your blood clots unusually fast. BleedingTime decays 1.5x faster (wounds clot faster) and active bleed death rate is reduced to 50 percent of normal.

name: Tinkerer
description: You love taking things apart and putting them back together. +1 to Electrical, Mechanics, Tailoring, and Flint Knapping.

name: Top Heavy
description: Your upper-body bulk makes nimble movement harder. Nimbleness XP gain and base agility are reduced.

name: Trackman
description: +2 to Trapping. Your traps never lose condition from use.

name: Trekker
description: +1 to Fitness and Sprinting. Walking does not drain endurance, and the extra walking calorie burn is reduced back to the normal passive rate.

name: Two-Handed
description: You favour weapons that require both hands. +2 to Axe, Long Blade, Long Blunt, and Spear.

name: Unwavering
description: Fear never really got its hooks into you. Every 10 in-game minutes, if panic is above 10, panic is reduced by 10.

name: Vagabond
description: A life on the road taught you where to look and what to grab. Chance to find a bonus useful item when looting containers and corpses.

name: Vehophobic
description: Getting behind the wheel or into a vehicle fills you with dread. The fear is irrational but it is very real.

name: Weakly Bleeding Wounds
description: Active bleeding drains your health at 60 percent of the normal rate. Wound clotting speed is unchanged.

name: Weather Sensitive
description: Your mood shifts with the sky. Storms drag you down; clear days lift you up more than they should.

name: Wild Plant Allergy
description: Foraged plants that others eat without concern leave you feeling ill. Wild food carries real risk for you.

name: Wildsman
description: +1 to Plant Scavenging and Fishing. 30 percent more forage yield. Fish you catch weigh 50 percent more and provide 50 percent more nutrition.

name: Wood Splitter
description: +1 Axe. Grants Ax-pert's 50% bonus tree damage and faster axe attacks. Eligible for the rare pine-tree key ring. Cannot be combined with another source of Ax-pert.
